entries.name: Bluebird Barbecue
entries.note: Smokehouse open since 2012 ends its run Oct. 31; final three nights are curbside pickup only, 4:30 to 7:30 pm.

entries.name: Vermont Pub & Brewery
entries.note: The state's pioneering brewpub closes after service Nov. 14, citing business that never recovered after 2020; specials planned for final days.

entries.name: Onyx Tonics (move to Pine St)
entries.note: Coffee bar left College Street Oct. 28 and hopes to reopen in the former Kestrel spot on Pine the week of Nov. 9.

entries.name: The Grey Jay
entries.note: Honey Road team's brunch and lunch spot closed after Oct. 12 service; gift cards are honored at Honey Road.

entries.name: Haymaker Bun (Burlington café)
entries.note: Retail café ended Oct. 17 and became a wholesale bun bakery; buns still sold at Brio Coffeeworks across the hall.

entries.name: Kismayo Kitchen
entries.note: Closed in September after a FEMA buyout deal for the building; reopened Oct. 10 under new operators while hunting for a permanent home.

entries.name: Bowl & Roll
entries.note: Counter-service rice bowls, poke and kati-style wraps mixing Nepali-Indian and Japanese flavors, in the former Magic Chopsticks space.

entries.name: Yên Vietnamese Café & Kitchen
entries.note: Donwoori owner's second restaurant, pho and Vietnamese coffee in a 35-seat room; expected by end of October, not yet confirmed open.

entries.name: Moss Café + Bar and Treetops (Sugar House Hotel)
entries.note: New hotel slated to open Nov. 5 with a lobby café-bar and an eighth-floor restaurant serving breakfast and dinner.

entries.name: El Bar (El Gato Cantina reopening)
entries.note: South Burlington move fell through, so the cantina reopened in its old spot as a sports bar with a pared-down menu.

entries.name: Vermont Tortilla
entries.note: Tortilla maker resumed production in Essex in late August; no walk-in shop, but preorders can be picked up by appointment.

entries.name: Radio Bean and Light Club Lamp Shop
entries.note: Music venue and café shut Sept. 8 over a $29,000 insurance bill; owner left the door open to a future reopening.

entries.name: Mule Bar expansion (former Our House Bistro)
entries.note: Bar is joining the next-door space this fall for a table-service dining room with bigger plates; weekend brunch planned for winter.

entries.name: Westford Provisions
entries.note: Country store and deli near the town common closed for good Sept. 30, citing rising costs.

entries.name: Taquería Don Richard
entries.address: University Mall food court, 155 Dorset St
entries.note: Mexican counter with handmade tortillas that opened in the U-Mall food court in late summer.

entries.name: Doña Esa dine-in at Doma Bar
entries.note: Homestyle Mexican takeout operation added sit-down dinner Sept. 12, Tuesday to Saturday, and later lunch seating.

entries.name: Glazed Donuts
entries.note: Home doughnut business opened a counter at the Essex Experience in late August; often sells out by mid-morning.

entries.name: Twisted Halo (Essex)
entries.address: Barns at Lang Farm, 45 Upper Main St
entries.note: Waitsfield doughnut shop opened a full-kitchen Essex location in July, known for its cruller-style churros.

entries.name: Meadow Roast Café
entries.address: Essex Towne Marketplace, 1 Market Pl, Bldg 3, Unit 25
entries.note: Café with house-made pastries and cooked breakfasts that opened in late March off Susie Wilson Road.

entries.name: Farmers & Foragers (downtown dining room)
entries.note: Chef told WCAX the Main Street dining room, in the former Café HOT space, should open by year's end.

entries.name: Artemus Café and Burlington Art Mini Museum
entries.note: Now open: the tiny Church Street café-gallery opened in August, pouring Brio coffee with free art admission.
entries.updates_existing: Artemus Café and Burlington Art Mini Museum

entries.name: Sabah's House
entries.note: Now open: the Marketplace kiosk opened in late June; chicken shawarma wraps are the big seller, open daily except Monday.

entries.name: Café Napoli
entries.note: Now open since Memorial Day weekend; owner is Dante Seguino, serving espresso, dirty sodas and house cakes.

entries.name: Clover Café
entries.note: Opened St. Patrick's Day 2026 and took off on TikTok for its cold-foam lattes.

entries.name: J.Jill
entries.note: Grand opening was scheduled for 10 a.m. Oct. 29, with opening-weekend promotions through Nov. 1.

entries.name: Vermont Comedy Arts theater
entries.note: Still not open: the 35-seat basement theater's timing slipped to October or November, with no firm date.

entries.name: Lippa's Estate & Fine Jewelry (Colchester)
entries.note: Seven Days reported in August that the jeweler has completed its summer move from Church Street to Colchester.

entries.name: Burlington Business Association
entries.note: Downtown business advocacy group is shutting down after nearly 50 years; Building Burlington's Future and the Lake Champlain Chamber are taking over its work.

entries.name: Burlyaxe Throwing
entries.note: Axe-throwing venue closed its North Winooski Avenue space after seven years; its mobile axe trailer still takes event bookings.

entries.name: Green Mountain Habitat ReStore (Williston)
entries.note: Habitat for Humanity's thrift and building-supply store reopened Aug. 15 after an April fire.

entries.name: Natural Nest Play Café
entries.note: Montessori-style indoor play space for kids with a coffee bar for parents; reservations from $20 for two hours.

entries.name: Perkins Museum of Geology
entries.note: UVM's free geology museum, home of the Charlotte Whale, reopened after six years; open weekdays 9 to 4.

entries.name: Phun entertainment center
entries.address: next to Hannaford, Essex Experience area
entries.note: Under construction: duckpin bowling, high-tech darts, an arcade and a sports bar from the Essex Experience owner; no opening date.

leads.name: Nightclub at former Nectar's building (188 Main St)
leads.what_was_filed: Zoning applications submitted by nightclub operator Shawn Cliche for a three-floor live music, food and entertainment venue
leads.note: Still awaiting zoning approval; Cliche does not own the Nectar's name. WCAX covered it Oct. 15 too. Not an opening.

gaps: Web search budget ran out before I could confirm status for these opening-soon entries: Sneakeasy (grand opening was set for Aug. 27, never confirmed), Mirabelles / 'Belles on the River, Old Brick Store outpost (Public Service VT), Judi's Ice Cream City Center, PopUp Bagels, Thingz From Yaad downtown (only a May Reddit hint that it opened), Whim Boutique, Savu Sauna bathhouse, Farmhouse Tap & Grill Williston.

Burlington Free Press was not checked: its sitemap returns 'Access Restricted.' mychamplainvalley.com started bot-blocking article pages mid-run, so its stories were found from sitemap titles and edition notes; I could not read the Burlyaxe article directly.
Church Street Marketplace and City of Burlington announcements were not checked.

Seven Days' foodnews RSS URL returns an empty page, so I used the site's WordPress API to list every post from Aug. 1 to Oct. 29 instead. WCAX, NBC5 and VTDigger were covered through their sitemaps or APIs, filtered by headline.

Left out as not openings or closings: Poco stopped dinner and reopened for lunch only Sept. 12; Venetian Cocktail & Soda Lounge is for sale but still open; MK Clothing was sold and stays open; Essex Experience shopping center is for sale; Charlie's Boathouse property is becoming parkland, opening probably next spring; Skinny Pancake's Lawson's tap takeover; Bove's demolition permits were pulled.
Westford Provisions is in Chittenden County but outside the seven named towns; drop it if the guide's area is strict.

Meadow Roast Café (opened March) and Twisted Halo Essex (opened July) opened before Aug. 1. They are included because the guide lacks them and fall coverage re-reported them. Their dates are old, so just_opened should not fire.
Out of area, so excluded: Essex Ice Cream Cafe (Essex, NY), Chipotle (Berlin), Burlington Bagel's St. Albans location, Ondis (Montpelier), Chico's (Montpelier), Blue Paddle Bistro (South Hero).
Ray's Seafood needs no update. The existing entry (closed Sept. 12) matches Seven Days, which gives the address as 7 Pinecrest Drive, Essex.
